items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I made a short for Louie all over Europe, and this was what Edward R. Murrow took us on.

ctx.x: What about shorts? Did the Lunceford band make some shorts?

Yeah, but I wasn't with him then. He made shorts, but I wasn't with him then. I made a short for Louie all over Europe, and this was what Edward R. Murrow took us on. It was -- I think it was about a 90 minute short, Louie and me.

He just took different parts of concerts and we -- he chartered a plane, and we flew over the Alps, in the air. They had a lot of seats out of the plane, and they were taking pictures up in that plane, little plane.
